final: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget) SELECT per_event.link_to_event, per_event.avg_spent, per_event.avg_remaining, per_event.avg_remaining - overall.avg_remaining FROM per_event CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.avg_remaining IS NOT NULL ORDER BY per_event.avg_remaining - overall.avg_remaining DESC LIMIT 10
